descriptions.root: The single-asset runtime as its own repository. Working path: AGENTS.md → module names → README_module_<name>.md → the module's own skills → code.
descriptions.Makefile: Entrypoint of everything — per-asset fan-out, JOBS measured from cores and memory, OMP threads pinned to 1 for determinism.
descriptions.docker-compose.yml: One image, two anchors: what every service is, and the one command the dashboard and the assets add.
descriptions.module_data/: Ingest — venue downloads, Lean ZIPs, one canonical DuckDB per asset.
descriptions.module_data/ingest.py: Selects one venue's whole candle per minute into the asset's canonical series (primary-failover, full grid).
descriptions.module_data/skills/: The module's own contract: candle canonicalisation, and the acquisition methodology beside it.
descriptions.module_ml/: Research — bars, features, triple-barrier labels, purged walk-forward XGBoost.
descriptions.module_ml/skills/: The module's own contract: the research methodology, equation by equation.
descriptions.module_ml/validation.py: Purged walk-forward splits and the frozen final holdout — the gate of the whole system.
descriptions.module_monitoring/: Presentation of what the runtime modules measured, and the one server that serves it.
descriptions.module_monitoring/serve.py: The one server, two roles: the dashboard, and a container reporting itself.
descriptions.module_monitoring/skills/: The module's own contract: the dashboard conventions and the drawing.
descriptions.module_monitoring/sub_module_dx/: This drawing: the tracked tree rendered by hand with `make monitoring-dx-update`.
descriptions.module_monitoring/sub_module_devops/: The DevOps panel, and the one container that holds the docker socket.
descriptions.module_monitoring/sub_module_devops/serv: The Docker Engine over its unix socket: the views, and the three verbs offered for this project's own containers.
descriptions.module_skills/: Repository-wide skills, and the index of the skills each module owns.
descriptions.store_assets_artifacts/: Per-asset artifacts — one folder per ticker, the asset's whole namespace: its database and every research file beside it. The raw tree and the run records are untracked, so the drawing does not hold them.

S1.name: S1 · Image and task definitions (Amazon ECR, Amazon ECS)

S3.name: S3 · data-ingest task (Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate)

S4.name: S4 · ml-research task per ASSET (Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate)

S5.name: S5 · One prefix per asset (Amazon S3)

S6.name: S6 · Static dashboard and one reader container (Amazon S3, Amazon CloudFront)

descriptions.root: The same tracked tree, read forward: every file and folder seated on the standard primitive its responsibility answers to — the right column of the mapping table in `module_skills/skill_pre_aws_solution.md`. Described and drawn, built nowhere.
descriptions.Dockerfile: The one image every stage runs in, `mlops-portfolio-1m-pipeline`: a container image in a registry (Amazon ECR), the runtime package of every task; there it carries the code the bind mount carries today.
descriptions.requirements.txt: The image's dependency layer, resolved when the image is built and read by no task at run time.
descriptions.docker-compose.yml: One task definition parameterised by `ASSET`, never a new unit per asset; the anchors are its local spelling, one service per ticker written out so the parameter stays visible.
descriptions.Makefile: The state machine whose states are the stages (AWS Step Functions): DownloadMarketData → BuildCanonicalData → AggregateBars → GenerateFeatures → GenerateLabels → SearchHyperparameters → TrainModel → EvaluateStrategy → PublishStatus. It sits above every stage and inside none; `all:` and `ml-all:` are the same order, read locally.
descriptions.module_data/: The data-ingest task: one container run per stage (an Amazon ECS Task on AWS Fargate) that fetches raw objects, builds the asset's canonical market object and exits, owning no state between runs.
descriptions.module_data/config.py: `TICKERS`, the one definition of the basket, and the descriptors that name the raw and canonical objects; `ASSET` is the parameter every run of the task takes.
descriptions.module_data/ingest.py: The BuildCanonicalData state: reads the raw objects under a venue and symbol prefix and writes the canonical market object back whole — the storage → ML-compute line begins at its output.
descriptions.module_data/status.py: The PublishStatus state for data: one status object for the whole basket, written by the one-off run and never fanned out.
descriptions.module_data/skills/: The module's own contract travels inside the task's code: a document, not a primitive.
descriptions.module_ml/: The ml-research task: the same Task shape parameterised by `ASSET` (`RunTask` with `ASSET=BTC`), one container run per stage from bars to strategy evaluation, reading and writing the asset's prefix and holding nothing between runs.
descriptions.module_ml/bars.py: The AggregateBars state, and the one write across the storage → ML-compute line: the three aggregation tables are a pure function of the canonical series, written back into the object the task read.
descriptions.module_ml/config.py: The descriptors that name every artifact object under the asset prefix, built on `artifact_dir()` of `module_data/config.py` and consumed by descriptor everywhere; a future `<prefix>/<ticker>/<version>/` is a rename there, not a redesign here.
descriptions.module_ml/validation.py: The gate of the whole system, and the same gate wherever it runs: purged walk-forward folds and the frozen final holdout are code inside the task, not a primitive.
descriptions.module_ml/status.py: The PublishStatus state for ML: the basket's status object as a fold over completed asset artifacts, and each asset's README as an artifact object under its prefix.
descriptions.module_ml/skills/: The research methodology travels inside the task's code: a document, not a primitive.
descriptions.store_assets_artifacts/: One prefix per asset in object storage (Amazon S3): the canonical market object, a versioned object pulled into a Task's own disk and written back whole, with the research artifacts as objects under the same prefix.
descriptions.store_assets_artifacts/BTC/: The `BTC` prefix: `BTC_research_ohlcv.duckdb` as the one versioned object, the parquets and JSONs as artifact objects keyed `BTC_<artifact>`; the tracked README and parameters are two of them.
descriptions.module_monitoring/: The static dashboard: the page files and the two snapshots as static objects behind a content-delivery front (Amazon S3 with Amazon CloudFront), and beside them one small reader container that stays running for the container, run and `/devops/*` routes.
descriptions.module_monitoring/config.py: Every address the reader knows — the internal port, the service names, the run record's paths — built once here; no code depends on a container name.
descriptions.module_monitoring/serve.py: The one process on this island: the registry, run and proxy routes are a container that stays running, while every file it serves today is a static object.
descriptions.module_monitoring/record.py: Writes the run object, `store_run_records/<run_id>/`, from inside whichever task ran the stage; its logs and 1 s samples are log streams keyed by stage and container, and metrics (Amazon CloudWatch).
descriptions.module_monitoring/index.html: The page: a static object; no process renders it.
descriptions.module_monitoring/data_status.json: A status object produced by data compute and read by the page — a static object beside the page today, tracked so a fresh clone opens on real numbers; its own prefix is a handful of edits away, listed in the skill's review table.
descriptions.module_monitoring/ml_status.json: A status object produced by ML compute, a fold over completed asset artifacts — a static object beside the page today, the same handful of edits away from its own prefix.
descriptions.module_monitoring/skills/: The page's conventions and this drawing's contract travel with the code: documents, not primitives.
descriptions.module_monitoring/sub_module_dx/: The repository's view — this drawing, a static object like the page, and not project code.
descriptions.module_monitoring/sub_module_devops/: The engine's views — a console, not project code; the socket it holds is a local mechanism with no primitive of its own.
descriptions.module_monitoring/sub_module_devops/serv: The one container that holds the docker socket: a console over the local engine's own inventory, a local mechanism.
descriptions.module_skills/: Repository-wide skills and the register: they travel with the code and deploy nowhere — not project code, not a primitive, and the contract of every boundary this picture draws.
descriptions.module_skills/skill_pre_aws_solution.md: The mapping table this view draws: its left column is the other view of this page, its right column is this one.
descriptions.AGENTS.md: The contract, where every boundary on this picture was decided; it deploys nowhere and governs everything that does.
descriptions.README.md: The overview: the domain drawing, and § Architectural direction, where this stance is stated in one paragraph.
